l4_steps.name: Define direct channel KPI targets and benchmarks
l4_steps.input: Annual commercial plan; prior-year direct channel share report; GDS cost-per-segment benchmark
l4_steps.output: Direct channel scorecard with targets: share %, conversion rate, cost per booking, ancillary attach rate
l4_steps.kpi: Direct channel share of total bookings ≥ 65%; cost per direct booking ≤ $3.50 vs. GDS ≥ $8.50
l4_steps.pain_point: No industry-standard benchmark for direct channel share forces reliance on internal year-on-year trend; low-cost carrier targets (70%+) may not be achievable without eliminating GDS completely

l4_steps.name: Select distribution schema — NDC 21.3 vs. EDIFACT
l4_steps.input: Agency and TMC capability survey; NDC adoption roadmap; current EDIFACT booking engine contract
l4_steps.output: Distribution schema decision: NDC 21.3 Offer/Order or legacy EDIFACT booking engine per channel segment
l4_steps.kpi: NDC-capable agency coverage ≥ 40% of managed travel volume within 12 months
l4_steps.pain_point: TMC and OTA NDC readiness varies widely; dual-schema support (NDC + EDIFACT) doubles integration maintenance burden and can create fare display inconsistencies

l4_steps.name: Configure NDC API Gateway offer and order schemas
l4_steps.input: NDC 21.3 IATA standard schema; fare family definitions from Pricing team; ancillary service catalog
l4_steps.output: Published IATA NDC AirShopping, OfferPrice, and OrderCreate API endpoints; certified schema documentation
l4_steps.kpi: API response time ≤ 800ms at p95; schema validation pass rate 100% on IATA conformance test suite
l4_steps.pain_point: NDC API latency degrades when Amadeus Altéa PSS availability calls chain through multiple O&D legs; caching strategy must balance freshness vs. response speed

l4_steps.name: Integrate Amadeus Altéa PSS real-time availability feed
l4_steps.input: NDC API Gateway offer request; Altéa inventory host connection parameters; RBD availability map
l4_steps.output: Live availability feed confirmed; booking class availability visible in web and app booking engines
l4_steps.kpi: Availability feed uptime ≥ 99.95%; stale availability incidents < 2 per month
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa PSS availability polling under peak traffic (holiday season surges) can cause throttling; CDN-layer availability caching introduces risk of selling closed inventory

l4_steps.name: Load fare products and ancillary catalog to web engine
l4_steps.input: ATPCO filed fares; ancillary service catalog (baggage, seat selection, meals, lounge); fare family branding rules
l4_steps.output: Published fare product tiles in web and app; ancillary catalog with pricing loaded; fare family descriptions live
l4_steps.kpi: Fare loading accuracy 100%; catalog sync from ATPCO to web engine ≤ 4 hours after fare filing
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO fare filing cycle (Cat 25 / branded fare rules) requires manual QA against web display; discrepancies between filed rules and displayed conditions create regulatory and consumer protection risk

l4_steps.name: Apply dynamic pricing rules for direct channel uplift
l4_steps.input: RM inventory O&D availability; direct channel booking cost differential vs. GDS; promotional calendar
l4_steps.output: Direct-only fare incentives configured; dynamic pricing rules active in booking engine; GDS parity exceptions documented
l4_steps.kpi: Direct channel average fare premium over GDS ≥ 0% (parity floor); promotional uplift in direct conversions ≥ 8% during campaign windows
l4_steps.pain_point: Fare parity clauses in GDS contracts prohibit offering lower fares on direct channel without also lowering GDS fares; undermines direct channel cost advantage and reduces RM flexibility

l4_steps.name: Validate fare display and regulatory compliance
l4_steps.input: Loaded fare products; DOT full-fare advertising rules (14 CFR Part 399); ancillary disclosure requirements
l4_steps.output: Compliance sign-off on fare display; all-in pricing confirmed; tax and fee disclosure checklist completed
l4_steps.kpi: Zero DOT full-fare advertising violations; fare display QA pass rate 100% pre-launch
l4_steps.pain_point: DOT Part 399 all-in pricing rules require taxes and fees displayed at first point of fare quotation; dynamic fee structures (carrier-imposed surcharges) change frequently and must be synced in real time

l4_steps.name: Monitor booking funnel conversion metrics in real time
l4_steps.input: Live web and app session data; funnel stage events (search → select → payment → confirm); device and channel segmentation
l4_steps.output: Real-time funnel dashboard; drop-off stage identification; conversion rate by device type and market
l4_steps.kpi: Overall booking conversion rate ≥ 3.5% (search-to-book); mobile app conversion ≥ 4.2%; funnel abandonment at payment ≤ 18%
l4_steps.pain_point: Session stitching across device and login state is unreliable without a persistent customer ID; anonymous user journeys cannot be attributed to downstream revenue, skewing funnel analysis

l4_steps.name: Run A/B tests on booking flow UX variants
l4_steps.input: Funnel drop-off report; UX hypothesis backlog; statistical significance threshold (95% confidence, n ≥ 5,000 sessions)
l4_steps.output: A/B test results report; winning variant identified or inconclusive flag; engineering backlog item for implementation
l4_steps.kpi: A/B test cycle time ≤ 3 weeks; conversion lift from winning variants ≥ 0.5% per test cycle
l4_steps.pain_point: Low-frequency route markets have insufficient traffic to reach A/B test statistical significance within acceptable test windows, forcing pooled analysis that dilutes route-specific behavioural insights

l4_steps.name: Optimise ancillary upsell prompts at checkout
l4_steps.input: Booking engine checkout step; passenger and itinerary data; ancillary pricing rules; upsell placement A/B test results
l4_steps.output: Configured upsell modules (seat upgrade, extra bag, EarlyBird equivalent, travel insurance); personalised offer rendering by traveller segment
l4_steps.kpi: Ancillary attach rate ≥ 45% of direct bookings; average ancillary revenue per direct booking ≥ $28
l4_steps.pain_point: Overly aggressive ancillary prompts increase checkout friction and raise abandonment; tension between ancillary revenue maximisation and conversion rate requires continual tuning of prompt timing and frequency

l4_steps.name: Submit payment to CyberSource gateway and tokenise card
l4_steps.input: Customer payment details (card or digital wallet); booking total; 3-D Secure 2.0 authentication trigger
l4_steps.output: Payment authorisation response; tokenised card stored for future purchases; transaction ID linked to PNR
l4_steps.kpi: Payment authorisation success rate ≥ 97%; 3DS2 frictionless flow rate ≥ 85%; gateway downtime ≤ 0.05% monthly
l4_steps.pain_point: 3-D Secure challenge flows increase checkout abandonment by 12–18%; SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) mandates in EU/UK apply when serving international routes and require issuer cooperation beyond airline control

l4_steps.name: Screen transaction for fraud risk with Accertify
l4_steps.input: Payment authorisation token; device fingerprint; IP geolocation; booking velocity signals; passenger name
l4_steps.output: Fraud risk score; approve / review / decline decision; case flagged for manual review if score 60–80
l4_steps.kpi: Fraud chargeback rate ≤ 0.05% of transaction value; false positive decline rate ≤ 0.8%; manual review queue cleared within 2 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Flight booking fraud patterns (mule accounts, card-not-present abuse on international routes) evolve faster than rule-update cycles; model retraining lag creates a window of elevated fraud exposure during new attack patterns

l4_steps.name: Confirm booking and issue PNR in Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Successful payment authorisation; passenger data (APIS fields); fare and ancillary items; flight inventory segment
l4_steps.output: Confirmed PNR with all segments, ancillaries, and payment record; booking confirmation email triggered
l4_steps.kpi: PNR creation success rate ≥ 99.9%; confirmation email delivery within 60 seconds of booking; seat inventory decremented correctly 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Race conditions between simultaneous bookings on the last seat in an RBD bucket can cause duplicate sells before Altéa inventory lock propagates; requires seat re-offer logic and customer compensation workflow

l4_steps.name: Accrue Rapid Rewards miles for direct booking
l4_steps.input: Confirmed PNR; Rapid Rewards member number; base fare paid; fare class earning multiplier rules
l4_steps.output: Miles posted to member account; bonus miles for direct channel booking applied; accrual confirmation in member portal
l4_steps.kpi: Miles posting accuracy 100%; accrual posted within 72 hours of booking; direct channel bonus miles correctly applied ≥ 99.5% of eligible transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Miles accrual rules for ancillary spend (seat upgrades, bags) are inconsistently applied when ancillaries are added post-booking via app; loyalty platform integration requires separate API call that can fail silently

l4_steps.name: Generate direct channel performance dashboard
l4_steps.input: Booking transaction data; channel attribution; ancillary revenue; fraud loss data; conversion funnel metrics; Rapid Rewards accrual volumes
l4_steps.output: Weekly direct channel performance dashboard: share %, booking volume, revenue per booking, ancillary attach, cost per booking, fraud rate
l4_steps.kpi: Dashboard refresh latency ≤ 4 hours; direct channel share reported to VP-level weekly; data completeness ≥ 99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Channel attribution is contested between direct and indirect when customers research on GDS/OTA then book direct; last-click attribution overstates direct channel contribution and misguides media spend decisions

l4_steps.name: Review direct channel share vs. target and escalate gaps
l4_steps.input: Weekly direct channel performance dashboard; annual KPI scorecard; commercial strategy review cadence
l4_steps.output: Gap analysis report; corrective action plan (promotions, UX fixes, NDC push, agency incentive review) if share < 65% target
l4_steps.kpi: Direct channel share ≥ 65%; month-over-month share growth ≥ 0.5pp when below target; corrective action plan issued within 5 business days of confirmed underperformance
l4_steps.pain_point: Structural direct channel share ceiling exists for airlines with large managed travel / TMC-dependent corporate customer base; share targets set for leisure mix may not apply to corporate-heavy routes without a distinct corporate portal strategy
